title: Cosmic Spider Oracle
description: Two young girls in colorful dresses stand on a glowing path beside a large ornate blue vase emitting floating bubbles. A massive mechanical spider with glowing orange eyes and a vibrant mandala on its back looms behind them against a cosmic night sky filled with swirling nebulae and stars, overlooking a futuristic city.
